title: Grateful Dead Live at Silva Hall, Hult Center on 1983-08-29
lineage: Master Cassettes (Technics RS-B48R, dbx decoded) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Mark Severson's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics (mics on pole, held head high, 50' from stage - row O, seats 208 & 209- DFC) > Jamie Pouris' custom preamp/NX40 dbx encoder > Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience capture of a high‑energy show with a rolling second set and balanced, distortion‑free sound.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a superb, well‑balanced audience pull that avoids the distortion found on other tapes of this concert. Fans note a fun, psyched atmosphere—especially in a rolling second set—making the performance feel like a highlight of an already great tour.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are positive, praising both the energetic show and the high‑quality, balanced audience recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Balanced sound throughout, no noticeable distortion; Mr. Severson's AUD pull captures the energy superbly.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set solid, second set described as rolling and very psyched after earlier Seattle/Portland shows.
